Lena (Design): dropped a short prototype — compact preview card for tool calls with an exposed primary action and inline schema hint. https://figma.com/file/new-proto (preview) Lena (Design): problem we keep hearing: users treat structured outputs as plain text and miss actions (open table / map to schema). need better affordance + clearer copy. Omar (DevEx): support ran a quick survey: 6/10 users expected an "Open" affordance. lightweight CTA that doesn't bloat the transcript would help. Priya (Frontend): implementation idea: show a right-edge primary CTA "Open table" for structured payloads, with an inline micro-hint left of it like "table · 3 rows". action is focusable and in DOM. sample markup: ```html
table · 3 rows 
[ ... ]
``` Priya (Frontend): note: when streaming, CTA shows a spinner and is aria-disabled until complete. avoid spamming ARIA updates. Niko (A11y): a11y notes: CTA must have descriptive label (e.g., "Open table viewer for excel_extract output"). make sure the hint is readable by screen readers as well, perhaps visually concise but with `aria-label` expanded. use `role=region` for the preview so screen readers can jump in. Sam (PM): telemetry: record `preview_action_click` + `preview_opened` and whether the user saw the hint before clicking (hover or focus). add small rate limit for streaming-enabled rows. Lena (Design): copy exploration: options for CTA text — "Open table", "View as table", "Open CSV". which is clearest? also micro-hint phrasing: "table · 3 rows" vs "3 rows" only. Omar (DevEx): prefer verbs: "Open table" is clear. hint should include type + count if available: "table · 3 rows" helps scanning. Priya (Frontend): accessibility + compactness compromise: show short hint visually but set `aria-label=\"table, 3 rows, generated by excel_extract\"` on the container. that surfaces full info to SR users. Niko (A11y): agree. also ensure keyboard nav: tab moves to CTA, Enter opens, focus moves into table viewer and announces "Table viewer opened" via polite live region. when returning, focus should go back to CTA. Lena (Design): visual variant B: instead of right-edge CTA, show a thin hover action strip that appears on hover/focus with icons for "Open" and "Copy". tradeoff: discoverability vs clutter. Sam (PM): decision needed for alpha: which default do we ship? right-edge CTA is more discoverable in dense transcripts. hover strip can come later. Priya (Frontend): perf caveat: many CTAs in long transcripts may increase tab stops. we can hide CTA on collapsed run-history rows and surface only in expanded previews. that keeps tab count low. Omar (DevEx): UX note: in run history compact rows, show micro-badge (icon + type) and a tiny chevron to expand — avoid full CTA there. users can expand if they need the CTA. Niko (A11y): ensure expand buttons have aria-expanded and aria-controls. when a row expands, programmatically move focus to the first interactive element inside the expanded region (preferably CTA). announce via live region: "Details expanded: Open table available". rate-limit announcements. Lena (Design): I'll run a 5-person hallway test tomorrow with the right-edge CTA + hint variant. will include tasks: find CSV, copy payload, open table, map schema. Sam (PM): add success metric: % of sessions where user opens table after preview shown. baseline = 18% from last month. target +10pp for alpha. Priya (Frontend): I'll implement the right-edge CTA in `devex/preview-actions-2165432100`. ETA 3 days. will include a11y attributes and streaming state. Niko (A11y): I'll pair on DOM semantics during implementation and run SR tests (VoiceOver + NVDA). also writing a short checklist: focus order, live region messaging, aria-disabled semantics for streaming. ux-bot: accessibility checklist suggested: contrast, focus visible, aria-expanded, aria-controls, polite live region for open/close, announce CTA state changes only. Omar (DevEx): copy pick: :thumbsup: for "Open table", :eyes: for "View as table". please react. Lena (Design): :thumbsup: Priya (Frontend): :thumbsup: Niko (A11y): :thumbsup: Sam (PM): :thumbsup: Omar (DevEx): thanks — landing mocks and test script today. will tag QA once PR is up.
